title: Тренажер Спецвопросов (Wh- + did)
description: Составь специальные вопросы (Wh- + did) из слов.

items.question: she / What / eat / did / last night
options: What did she eat last night?
What she did eat last night?
What did eat she last night?
items.answer: What did she eat last night?

items.question: film / see / they / did / When / the
options: When did they see the film?
When they did see the film?
When did see they the film?
items.answer: When did they see the film?

items.question: Where / did / you / buy / a car
options: Where did you bought a car?
Where did you buy a car?
items.answer: Where did you buy a car?
